props.headline: The questions change with the season.
props.emphasis: The answers have to keep up.
props.body: Aeration dates, holiday hours, a new winter dining schedule. What members ask in the fall is not what they asked in midsummer.

caption:
Every club's calendar rewrites its most common questions a few times a year. Aeration week brings one set. Holiday hours bring another. The first cold morning brings questions about frost and course openings.

The answers are usually published somewhere, but only if someone updates them when the season turns. An assistant is only as current as what the club gives it, so the seasonal update matters more than it used to.

What is the first question your members start asking this time of year?
firstComment: One habit worth borrowing: review the club's published hours and policies the week before each season turns.
